notes:
PocketScanTCG 0.6.0 adds a hidden benchmark lab for choosing a condition model on real shots.

- Settings → Benchmark lab enables a Compare models action on the condition checker.
- The same 23 prepared crops go to DeepSeek Flash, Gemma 4, Mistral Large 4 and MiMo V2.6 Pro in turn; every answer is measured and graded by the app's rulebook.
- The run stores the three originals, the exact crops sent, and per-model observations, condition, points, confidence, latency and token usage, with ZIP export and delete controls.
- Normal condition checks remain on DeepSeek; the Worker accepts only its allowlisted model pairs.

Debug build of the PocketScanTCG Android app (debug-signed). Sideload for testing.
